text: Zhik is a Sydney-based sailing-apparel company. Its 2023 equity crowdfunding raise was backed by its existing investors, including long-time backer Nightingale Partners, according to Inside Small Business; Marine Business News describes Nightingale Partners as a Sydney-based private equity group that led the existing shareholders' commitment.
short: Zhik is a Sydney company whose shareholders include Nightingale Partners.

source.name: Inside Small Business: Sailing apparel Zhik launches first crowdfunding campaign
source.quote: the Sydney-based company has partnered with crowdfunding platform Equitise and is backed by Zhik’s existing investors

additionalSources.name: Marine Business News: Zhik sails strong into 2023 with $4 million Equity Crowdfunding raise backed by Nightingale Partners
additionalSources.quote: Existing shareholders, led by Nightingale Partners a Sydney-based Private Equity group, have committed to investing $800,000 in this round
